channel.title: Durlabh Sunday · Talaash Heritage
channel.description: Durlabh means rare, hard to find. Every Sunday Talaash Heritage takes one rare subject from India's past, in archaeology, linguistics, anthropology, arts, Sanskrit, history or heritage, and studies it properly. Each episode is the narrated lecture; the full long read, with every source listed, is on talaash-heritage.pages.dev/durlabh.
